1. What Birth Code is

Birth Code calculates your birth chart on your device and turns it into readings about your image, style, communication, relationships and self-expression. It is a tool for self-reflection and entertainment. It is not medical, psychological, legal or financial advice — see the separate Disclaimer, which forms part of these terms.

3. Acceptable use

Birth Code is meant to be used by you, about yourself, and about people who are happy for you to look at their chart. Please do not enter another person's birth details if they would not want you to, and do not use anything the app shows you to pressure, diagnose, judge or make decisions about someone else's life. What you do with a shared image is your responsibility.

The birth details, saved tips and mood boards you create belong to you. They stay on your device; we neither host nor claim any rights in them. You are responsible for keeping your own backups (the app can save one to a file): if you delete the app or lose the phone without a backup, the data is gone, and we cannot restore it.

Disclaimer

Birth Code is made for self-reflection and entertainment. Your chart is calculated from the birth details you enter and read as a symbolic language — a mirror to think with, a way of noticing yourself. It describes possibilities, never certainties, and predicts nothing.

Nothing here is medical, psychological, legal or financial advice. If something concerns your health, your mind, your money or your rights, please speak to a qualified professional. No reading in this app can replace that conversation, and it is not meant to.

Your decisions remain entirely your own. Take what feels true, leave what does not, and let no text here — however beautiful — decide who you are, whom you love, or what you do next. You are the author of your life.
